name: Tic Tac Toe
author: Rafael Jacov Medel
description: Noughts and crosses against a friend or an unbeatable minimax bot with three levels. Tap to play. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

descriptions.en: Noughts and crosses against a friend or an unbeatable minimax bot with three levels. Tap to play. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.
descriptions.it: Tris contro un amico o contro un bot minimax imbattibile, con tre livelli. Tocca per giocare. Un gioco LÖVE sul motore Lua App.
